entries.1d6c5cde66247a62: The company conducts an adhesive tape business through Uni Kogyo Co., Ltd. and a handicraft business through Hobbyra Hobbyre Co., Ltd. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,458 million.
entries.297063df11dec810: This business manufactures and sells writing instruments and writing-related products such as cosmetics, applying technology developed in the writing instrument business. In Japan, products are manufactured by uni Co., Ltd., Yamagata Mitsubishi Pencil Seiko Co., Ltd., Unipolymer Co., Ltd. and others, and overseas, by Shenzhen Xinhualing Stationery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and subsidiaries in Vietnam and others. Sales are handled by domestic sales companies and overseas sales companies, including uni-ball Corporation in the United States, and C. Josef Lamy GmbH manufactures and sells LAMY-brand writing instruments and others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥87,355 million.
entries.3b0e23285406964a: Writing Instruments and Related Products Business
entries.9b4f6cff4abf2129: The group consists of the company and 50 subsidiaries, and conducts the Writing Instruments and Related Products Business and other businesses. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥89,814 million, and the reportable segments are two: the Writing Instruments and Related Products Business and Other Businesses.
entries.c8305fb5cdd53abb: A manufacturer that sells writing instruments such as pencils and ballpoint pens, and writing-related products such as cosmetics, in more than 100 countries around the world.
